workspace-help.stdout:
Expose this workspace to the Computer Hub (via the leader).

Workspace sharing is enabled per account. Set `ASTER_WORKSPACE_COMMAND=1` to enable it locally for testing.

Usage: aster workspace [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  start    Start (or update) the workspace-to-hub exposure
  pause    Drain and disconnect from the hub, keeping the exposure warm
  resume   Reconnect a paused exposure to the hub
  stop     Stop exposing the workspace (the leader keeps running)
  restart  Restart the exposure (stop, then start with the given options)
  status   Show the current workspace-exposure status [alias: list]
  help     Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --debug
          Enable debug logging

      --debug-file <FILE>
          Write debug logs to FILE

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

      --leader-socket <PATH>
          Use a custom leader socket path instead of the default `~/.aster/leader.sock`. A local/branch build can thus run an isolated leader without colliding with the default one already running on the machine Name it `~/.aster/leader-*.sock` to keep `aster leader list/kill` able to find it; any other location works but won't be auto-discovered

setup-no-principal.stderr:
No deployment key or team sign-in found.

To install managed configuration, sign in with a team using `aster login`,
or set a deployment key:

  export ASTER_DEPLOYMENT_KEY=<your-key>
  aster setup

Or add the key to ~/.aster/config.toml:

  [endpoints]
  deployment_key = "<your-key>"

If you don't have a deployment key, contact your organization's Aster administrator.
